servers.name: filesystem
servers.notes: Replace /path/to/allowed/dir with the directory you want to expose. Multiple directories can be specified.

servers.name: fetch
servers.description: Make HTTP requests and fetch web content
servers.notes: Fetches URLs and returns content. Supports various content types.

servers.name: memory
servers.notes: Stores entities and relations in a knowledge graph for persistent memory across sessions.

servers.name: sequentialthinking
servers.notes: Helps break down complex problems into sequential reasoning steps.

servers.name: time
servers.description: Get current time and timezone conversions
servers.notes: Provides current time in various timezones and converts between them.

servers.name: playwright
servers.notes: Full browser automation via Playwright. Headless by default. Additional coordinate, PDF, and testing tools are available with --caps=vision, --caps=pdf, and --caps=testing.

servers.name: browser-use
servers.notes: Runs the Browser Use local MCP server over stdio. Set OPENAI_API_KEY, or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as an alternative. Optional: BROWSER_USE_HEADLESS=false to show the browser window, BROWSER_USE_DISABLE_SECURITY=true to disable browser security features.

servers.name: brave-search
servers.description: Web search via Brave Search API
servers.notes: Requires BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable. Get key at https://brave.com/search/api/

servers.name: link
servers.description: Create secure, one-time-use Link payment credentials for agent checkout flows
servers.notes: Requires a Link account. Run link-cli auth login to authenticate. Optional overrides: LINK_API_BASE_URL, LINK_AUTH_BASE_URL, LINK_HTTP_PROXY.

servers.name: context7
servers.description: Up-to-date code documentation for LLMs and AI code editors
servers.notes: Fetches current documentation and code examples for libraries. Optional API key from https://context7.com/dashboard for higher rate limits (pass --api-key YOUR_KEY).

servers.name: slack
servers.notes: Requires SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_TEAM_ID. Create Slack app at https://api.slack.com/apps

servers.name: clerk
servers.description: Access Clerk SDK snippets and implementation patterns
servers.notes: Retrieves code examples for Clerk features. Uses streamable HTTP transport via mcp-remote.

servers.name: gemini-media
servers.description: Analyze audio, video, images, PDFs, and YouTube URLs with Gemini; generate and edit images
servers.notes: Use analyze_media for YouTube URLs or absolute file paths to audio, video, image, or PDF files. Use generate_image for image generation and edits. Set GEMINI_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY; set GEMINI_MEDIA_GCS_BUCKET only for local file paths.

servers.name: exa
servers.description: Web, code, company, and people search via Exa
servers.notes: Optional query params: tools=tool1,tool2 to enable extra tools; default tools are web_search_exa, get_code_context_exa, company_research_exa. Optional exaApiKey=YOUR_EXA_API_KEY to use your key. Local npm server uses EXA_API_KEY.

servers.name: supabase
servers.description: Manage Supabase projects, databases, edge functions, and storage
servers.notes: Replace <project-ref> with your project ID from Supabase dashboard. Uses OAuth via browser. Add ?read_only=true for safer ops. Add ?features=database,docs to limit tool groups. For dev/testing only.

servers.name: deepwiki
servers.description: Ask questions and read AI-generated documentation for public GitHub repositories via DeepWiki
servers.notes: Free remote server, no authentication required. Public repositories only; private repos need a Devin account with the Devin MCP server. Uses streamable HTTP at /mcp (the /sse endpoint is deprecated).

servers.name: shadcn
servers.description: Browse, search, and install shadcn/ui components from registries
servers.notes: Requires components.json in project root. Configure registries in components.json. Supports @shadcn (default), private registries, and third-party sources.
